matt: Drafting a safe canary for integrating FlashAttention v2/v3 into the runtime. Objectives: preserve p95 SLAs, avoid mem/OOM regressions for long-context requests, and capture kernel-level telemetry.

Plan outline:
- "attn_kernel_mixer" flag with modes: off, v2_only, v3_prefer, adaptive.
- Selector will use a composite score: latency_est - mem_penalty + compatibility_bonus.
- Default adaptive: prefer v3 for seq <= 1024 when score margin > 0.15; otherwise pick v2.
- Add emergency OOM guard: on alloc failure or fragmentation detect -> immediate fallback + incr counter.

Selector pseudocode:
```
if flag == "off": use legacy
elif flag == "v2_only": use v2
elif flag == "v3_prefer": if seq <= 1024 and free_mem > 5GB: use v3 else use v2
else: # adaptive
  s2 = predict(v2, seq) - mem_penalty(v2)
  s3 = predict(v3, seq) - mem_penalty(v3)
  if s3 - s2 > 0.15: use v3 else use v2
```

Perf snapshot from local harness (single-GPU rtx-prod-like):
```
model=gpt-medium batch=8
seq=256  p50: v2=12.4ms v3=8.9ms | mem v2=3.1GB v3=3.7GB
seq=1024 p50: v2=47.2ms v3=34.1ms | mem v2=6.7GB v3=9.0GB
seq=2048 p50: v2=112ms v3=98ms  | observed v3 fragmentation spikes
```

Batching heuristics:
- adaptive_max_batch = min(ceil(24000 / avg_seq_len_last_min), 64)
- extend batch_wait to 12ms only when backlog < 3 and tail_ratio > 0.15
- tag traces with batching_strategy=attn-mixer-adaptive

KV cache handling:
- If v3 indicates paged-kv mismatch or mem-frag, fallback to paged-v2 flow.
- Emit kv_page_hit_rate, kv_page_miss, kv_fallback_count.

Telemetry & alerts (Sara): p50/p95/p99 per model+kernel, tokens/s, kernel_oom_count, kernel_fallback_count, gpu_mem_free_hist.

Canary proposal:
- Start 10% for 4h using deterministic assignment (request_id % 100 < 10).
- Accept if p95 delta <= +10% and kernel_oom_count == 0 and tokens/s drop < 8%.
- Escalate to 50% for 6h if healthy. Rollback on any OOM or p95 delta > +25%.

Action items:
- matt: push selector prototype + unit tests
- kate: add CLI flag, docs snippet, max_seq_reserve=1500 default
- dave: unit + stress tests for OOM guard, run longer ramp to 4k seq
- prashant: implement adaptive batching and tagging
- sara: dashboards + runbook + alerts; I'll watch canary

Quick logs from the stress run:
`[2026-03-17T18:22:03Z] kernel=v3 alloc 9.6GB -> fragmentation flagged; fallback->v2`
`[2026-03-17T18:22:04Z] selector: adaptive chose v3 (delta=0.12) but fallback_count++`

Questions:
- Canary percent: propose 10% deterministic. OK?
- Rollback thresholds: are the deltas conservative enough?

kate: LGTM. Two asks: 1) Make canary deterministic (hash by user or request id). 2) Default prefer v2 if seq >= 1500 unless explicit opt-in. I'll take CLI+docs.

dave: I'll wire stress harness and add a synthetic fragmentation test. Seen intermittent fragmentation at seq=2048, agree on OOM guard.

sara: I'll set up the dashboards and alerts. Plan to watch the canary live. Alert on any kernel_oom_count > 0 or p95 increase > 20%.

prashant: I'll prototype adaptive batch and run throughput tests. Using adaptive_max_batch and 12ms window under low backlog.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: 10% -> attn_kernel_mixer=adaptive on prod-east (run cb-20260318-02). Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/cb-20260318-02

matt: Thanks. I'll open the PR with selector, tests, and a small harness. Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT if canary goes ahead.
